content.axes: centre of both squares at (0,0); x to the right, y upward
content.direction: anticlockwise (left along the top, down the left side, right along the bottom, up the right side)

diagram.manim_description: Draw two concentric squares centred at (0,0), both outlines INK (uniform 3 px stroke, no fill): the outer square 150 units on a side with corners (-75,-75), (75,-75), (75,75), (-75,75), and the inner square 100 units on a side with corners (-50,-50), (50,-50), (50,50), (-50,50); the lane between them is 25 units wide on every side. Draw four solid INK block arrows, each 24 units long and 12 units high, in the middle of the lanes, showing the anticlockwise running direction: top lane centred at (0, 62.5) pointing left; left lane centred at (-62.5, 0) pointing down; right lane centred at (62.5, 0) pointing up; bottom lane centred at (-30, -62.5) pointing right. Draw the finishing line as one vertical INK pole, 4 px wide, from (0,-30) to (0,-88); it crosses the inner bottom side at (0,-50) and the outer bottom side at (0,-75). Attach two solid FOCUS right-pointing triangular flags to the pole: the inner flag with corners (0,-36), (0,-46), (14,-41) just above the inner bottom side, and the outer flag with corners (0,-61), (0,-71), (14,-66) just above the outer bottom side. Write 'Common Finishing Line' in INK centred at (0,-98), under the lower end of the pole. Write '150 m' in INK centred at (0, 84), above the top side of the outer square, and '100 m' in INK centred at (0, 41), inside the inner square just under its top side. Nothing else is drawn: no letters A or B, no dots, no route. Background BG. Fit the whole figure, from the label at the top to the label at the bottom, in the 16:9 card, centred, with an even margin.
must_not_show: the starting points A and B or any route
any distance tag or answer working
accuracy_checks: Outer side 150, inner side 100, concentric, lane 25 wide on every side
Arrows show anticlockwise running: left on top, down on the left, right on the bottom, up on the right
Pole at x = 0 crosses both bottom sides at their midpoints, 75 from each outer corner and 50 from each inner corner
No A or B and no route is drawn
diagram.alt_text: Two concentric square tracks, 150 m and 100 m on a side, with arrows running anticlockwise and a common finishing line with flags at the middle of the bottom sides.
diagram.render_note: Book figure P06 is not to scale (the printed inner square is about 0.55 of the outer one, not 0.67); this diagram is to scale and centred. The finishing line is drawn at the exact middle of the bottom sides, as the text says. The bottom arrow, which the book draws inside the inner square, is placed in the bottom lane (same direction, right).
